sensors.keyBindPolicy.label: Require approval of sensor keys
sensors.keyBindPolicy.description: Off (default): a sensor with an API key replaces it with a signing key it makes itself, once and audited; its API key then stops working. On: such a sensor keeps its API key until an administrator re-pairs it. Turning it off needs the permission to widen sensor grants.

sensors.install.trustCollector.label: Trust this collector to push asset reports
sensors.install.trustCollector.help: A new collector starts untrusted, and the platform refuses every report it sends until it is trusted. Trusted lets it send asset reports without a job: they can add new assets but never change existing ones, and scope exclusions still apply. Tick this only for a collector you install yourself. It is audited and every administrator is notified.
sensors.install.trustCollector.noPermiss: Only an administrator who may widen sensor grants can trust a collector. You can create it now and have it trusted later on the sensor's Grant.
sensors.install.trustCollector.notApplie: The collector was created, but trusting it failed. It stays untrusted until it is promoted on the sensor's Grant.
sensors.grant.collectorRefused.untrusted: This collector's reports are refused: it is not trusted

Its grant allows asset reports, but a sensor that is not trusted cannot send results without a job, so the platform refuses every report it sends. Promote it to Trusted if you installed it and know where it runs.
sensors.grant.collectorRefused.grantTitl: This collector's reports are refused: its grant does not allow them
sensors.grant.collectorRefused.grantBody: Its grant does not allow results without a job, so the platform refuses every report it sends. Change its profile to Collector, then promote it to Trusted.
sensors.grant.collectorRefused.askAdmin: An administrator who may widen sensor grants can change this.
sensors.review.sandboxConfined: Each scan task reaches only its targets. This sensor can take jobs that need confinement (a web scope).
sensors.review.sandboxUnknown: This sensor does not report its sandbox (an older release). Jobs that need confinement go to other sensors.
sensors.review.sandboxNotConfined: Jobs that need confinement (a web scope) go to other sensors. Run the container with the sensor's seccomp profile; its setup checklist names the cause.

sensors.grant.suggestion.title: Suggested grant: {profile}
sensors.grant.suggestion.idleBody: This sensor did nothing in the window. The default profile of its kind is suggested.
sensors.grant.suggestion.body: The narrowest profile that admits every job this sensor ran. It is never wider than the current grant; the trust level is kept.
sensors.grant.suggestion.confirmDesc: From its next request the sensor gets only the jobs this profile admits. A job outside it (for example a schedule that did not run in the window) is refused and named in the sensor timeline. You may be asked to confirm your identity. This is audited.
